text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of an overdosage with VYALEV, the infusion should be stopped immediately. Administer intravenous fluids and maintain an adequate airway. Electrocardiographic monitoring should be used, and the patient observed carefully for the development of cardiac arrhythmias; if necessary, an appropriate antiarrhythmic therapy should be given. Patients must also be monitored for hypotension.
